text:
kevin: quick heads-up — nightly perf reg showed ~25% token latency regression on our long-seq chat workload after we flipped to cublasLt default for matmuls. ran an nsys trace, attaching the highlights inline. :frowning:

maria: ugh. do you have the kernel timeline? curious if it's a different algo or workspace thrash.

kevin: pasted snippets from nsys timeline and a few cublasLt logs. main things i noticed:
- cuBLASLtSgemm kernels (algo_id ~ 88/93 in some ranges) are way slower than prior cuBLAS algos for the 4096x8192x4096 shapes we see at decode steps with big KV cache lookups.
- workspace allocations spike when sequence length > 1024. cublasLt reports needing ~120MB workspace for the algo chosen at runtime.

--- nsys timeline excerpt ---
[GPU] 0:00:00.123  cuBLASLtMatMul (algo 88)  duration: 1.8 ms  active SM: 60%
[GPU] 0:00:00.127  cuBLASLtMatMul (algo 93)  duration: 2.1 ms  active SM: 62%
[GPU] 0:00:00.130  cuBLASMatMul (legacy)  duration: 0.95 ms  active SM: 85%
[CPU] 0:00:00.140  host memcpy (workspace alloc)  size: 128MB  duration: 0.25 ms
[GPU] 0:00:00.142  kernel stall on mem alloc
--- end ---

kevin: also dumped cublasLt algo picks for a few runs:
```
cublasLt: algo_id=88, tile=128x128, requires_workspace=120MB, est_gflops=1240
cublasLt: algo_id=93, tile=256x64, requires_workspace=120MB, est_gflops=1100
cublas:  algo_id=7 (legacy), requires_workspace=0MB, est_gflops=1320
```

ash: interesting that legacy cuBLAS outperforms cublasLt for our shapes. could be kernel selection heuristics picking workspace-heavy tilings that don't match our SRAM/cache characteristics.

maria: did you run with deterministic algo selection disabled? cublasLt has heuristic + search mode; if search picks a bad workspace-heavy algo once, subsequent runs may reuse it.

kevin: i forced search mode off and set override to prefer workspace=0 and we get back to baseline:
```
export CUBLASLT_ALLOW_ALGO_SEARCH=0
export REDWOOD_CUBLAS_PREFER_LEGACY=1  # local env hack
```
Result: matmul latency back to ~1.0 ms for that op and whole-request p50 down 18%. p95 improved ~22%.

perf-bot: :eyes: queued perf job 1749504330 to run controlled A/B across 20 runs with seq=2048/4096, batching on/off. results to follow.

ash: this smells like interaction with KV cache batch coalescing. when we coalesce many small decodes into larger batched matmuls the tiling choices and workspace round up cause extra alloc/free churn. can you repro with synthetic shapes?

kevin: yes — synthetic runner:
```
python perf_runner.py --M 4096 --N 8192 --K 4096 --seq 4096 --batch 8 --use_cublaslt
nsys profile -o tmp/trace --trace=cuda,kernels python perf_runner.py ...
```
With batch=1 and seq=4096 legacy cuBLAS slightly faster; with batch=8 cublasLt default becomes worse (workspace allocs multiply).

maria: potential mitigations:
- add workspace budget cap in runtime and fall back to legacy cuBLAS when workspace > X MB
- extend our kernel selector to consider batched/multi-call patterns (total workspace across batched ops) instead of per-op heuristics
- cache selected algo keyed by (M,N,K,seq,batch) and validate periodically with microbenchmarks

kevin: i prototyped a cheap heuristic: prefer_workspaceless=true if batch_size * workspace > 256MB. quick A/B shows it avoids regression in 90% of cases. downside: might lose gflops on some single, large ops.

ash: conservative default seems reasonable for now. we can surface a config flag for Dedicated customers who want raw perf and can reserve bigger workspace.

maria: can you drop the nsys flamegraph snippet into #eng-infra or attach perf-bot artifact? would be helpful for SRE/infra to see memory alloc/free correlation.

kevin: perf-bot uploaded traces to s3: s3://redwood-perf/1749504321/nsys_trace.qdrep + txt logs. summary baseline vs cublasLt:
```
baseline (legacy): p50 matmul=0.95ms p95=1.2ms
cublasLt-default: p50 matmul=1.75ms p95=2.4ms
cublasLt-with-budget-fallback: p50=1.02ms p95=1.35ms
```

perf-bot: AB test results posted: AB job 1749504330 complete. group A (legacy) mean end-to-end latency 112ms, group B (cublasLt default) mean 138ms. Details in artifact.

maria: ok action items:
- kevin: open PR for workspace-budget fallback + feature flag (eng-runtime) — include configurable threshold and telemetry for how often fallback triggers.
- ash: add a microbench harness to CI that runs synthetic matmuls for frequent shapes from production KV cache distribution.
- infra: consider reserving pinned GPU memory for workspace allocations to avoid host-side alloc stalls.

kevin: will do PR today, include nsys snapshot and sample config. tagging @ash for review.

ash: thanks — also let's add a note in the rollout doc about cublasLt search being non-deterministic across driver versions; include driver version in perf metadata.

kevin: noted. I'll include driver/cuda/cuBLAS versions in the PR and in perf telemetry.

maria: :thumbsup: sounds good. if perf-bot AB confirms, let's flip default heuristic for next canary.

kevin: thanks all. will follow up with PR link and trace artifacts.
